horizons.label: T+0 (Same-day)
horizons.statistical_rationale: Captures distressed/urgent travel demand; essential for CPI accuracy as these fares reflect maximum willingness to pay

horizons.label: T+3 (3-day advance)
horizons.statistical_rationale: Brackets the 3-day advance purchase boundary commonly used in airline revenue management systems

horizons.label: T+7 (1-week advance)
horizons.statistical_rationale: The 7-day boundary is a key revenue management threshold; prices typically step down significantly after this point

horizons.label: T+15 (2-week advance)
horizons.statistical_rationale: Captures the 14-day and 21-day advance purchase fare classes that represent planned business and early leisure bookings

horizons.label: T+30 (1-month advance)
horizons.description: Planned leisure travel — lowest regular prices
horizons.statistical_rationale: Represents baseline planned-travel pricing; serves as the anchor for booking-window analysis and price discrimination measurement

weighting_note: All booking horizons receive equal weight in the combined index. Production version could weight by actual booking pattern distribution from airline data.
